title: 🪨 Asteroid 2025 XR — Close Earth Flyby
description:
Asteroid 2025 XR makes its closest approach to Earth, passing at 0.6 lunar distances (217,915 km). For reference, the Moon is 1 lunar distance away — this asteroid will pass 0.6× farther than the Moon. There is no impact risk.

The asteroid has an absolute magnitude (H) of 24.8, suggesting a diameter of roughly 38 m and a flyby velocity of 18.3 km/s relative to Earth. Close approaches like this are opportunities for radar observation and scientific characterization.
